review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will lead design, implementation, administration, and optimization of enterprise-level networking solutions, ensuring that our systems are secure is critical for the company’s business model. What You’ll Do: Leads the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of enterprise-level networking solutions, including advanced routing and switching, VLAN segmentation, VPN architecture, LAN/WAN infrastructure, wireless networks, load balancing, secure external connectivity
eligibility_evidence: Location: Bloomington, Minnesota (Hybrid) | Full-Time Pay: $144,780.00  to $ 216,720.00 Ranked #8 Top Workplace  - Midsize Employer, MN About the Role: The Senior Network Engineer leads, implements, and supports the organizations network infrastructure technology.
This positing reports to corporate headquarters in MN and onsite work is required at times.
Significant Cash Benefit if You Opt Out of Our Health Plan Flexible hybrid work environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Develops requirements, participates in projects, leads projects as needed and keeps team members apprised of the status of projects relevant to the team’s area of specialty. 10 or more years of experience in network administration or engineering role,  including at least 2 years focused on enterprise-level network design, implementation, and optimization. Expertise in network architecture, performance tuning, and security best practices. Proficient with firewalls, VPNs, secure authentication mechanisms, network access control, and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS).
